description: This Python source file defines classes and functions for managing distributed checkpoint processes in PyTorch. It includes configurations, communication protocols, subprocess management, and checkpoint writing logic tailored for distributed training environments.

classes.name: CheckpointProcess
classes.description: Manages a remote process for writing checkpoints in distributed training setups, handling subprocess creation, communication, and graceful shutdown.

classes.name: CheckpointProcessConfig
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for initializing and shutting down the checkpoint subprocess.

classes.name: RequestType
classes.description: Enumeration of request types that can be sent to the checkpoint subprocess (e.g., ping, write checkpoint, terminate).

classes.name: WorkerRequest
classes.description: Dataclass encapsulating commands sent to the worker process, including the request type and associated payload.

classes.name: WorkerResponse
classes.description: Dataclass representing responses from the worker process, indicating success, errors, and response payload.
